articles.title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
articles.description: Some of the biggest names on Google's AI team got new jobs this week. In some cases, including for legendary Googler Jeff Dean, those jobs are no longer at Google. Given that Google's models seem to be behind the best of what's coming out of anthropic and OpenAI, is this a sign of Google in […]

articles.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
articles.description: OpenAI says it is pausing "internal activities" around an in-development AI model, Astra, because it doesn't yet meet new security standards the company is putting in place. The announcement follows its recent disclosure that OpenAI models accidentally hacked Hugging Face. Anthropic and Meta have also since admitted that they had AI models that went rogue […]

items.title: What’s behind the Google AI shake-up
items.summary: 谷歌AI团队多名核心成员本周离职，包括传奇人物杰夫·迪恩已离开公司。
items.why_it_matters: 顶尖人才流失可能加剧谷歌在AI竞赛中落后于竞争对手的风险。

items.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
items.summary: OpenAI因新模型Astra未达安全标准而暂停其内部开发活动。
items.why_it_matters: 此举反映大厂正收紧AI安全红线以应对模型失控引发的监管压力。

items.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
items.summary: 亚马逊为德州数据中心投资新建电厂，或成全美最大温室气体排放源之一。
items.why_it_matters: AI算力扩张带来的高能耗与碳排放问题正引发严峻环保争议。
